scope: Public comments, docstrings, documentation, notifications, and generated reports.
exception_rule: Exact file and content hashes permit reviewed Unicode input data only. Python comments and docstrings are never exempt.

unicode_data_exceptions.reason: Unmodified upstream MapLibre bundle contains Unicode glyph and vertical-writing character tables.

authored_unicode_data: Authored multilingual fixtures and character ranges use Unicode escapes while preserving runtime values.
